name: Miss roll
applies_to: Only when the target's Avoidance is above 0
detail: A draw at or above the chance is a Miss and the hit deals nothing. Accuracy and Avoidance take battle % and flat bonuses; Accuracy % and Avoidance % take flat ones only.

name: ATK
detail: A flat base line is scaled by that pool: battle ATK =⌊base × (1 + Σ ATK%) + Σ flat ATK⌋. Gear, runes and research build the base in managed code the client encrypts, so that part isn't read.

name: Skill coefficient
detail: A plain float on each hit. That it is the skill coefficient is inferred from its name and place; the code that writes it wasn't read.

name: Final DMG
detail: Battle bonuses add flat to the base rate; no % multiplier applies to it. A final DMG buff is most likely the same size whoever gives it, with no caster amp or ATK term (inferred).

name: Enemy DEF
detail: DEF is floored at 0 first. The curve keeps 42% at 3 × C_def and 29% at 10 × C_def, so shred pays most against low-DEF targets. C_def is server data.

name: Element
expression: adv: 1 + EDB + C_inc; res: 1 ÷ (1 + EDR_t + C_dec)
applies_to: Advantage or resistance only; a neutral hit is ×1
why: Light on Dark loses if C_dec + RES > 0.
detail: Fire beats Grass, Water beats Fire, Grass beats Water; Light and Dark beat each other, so a Light hit on Dark sets both and resistance wins. Element DMG adds; the target's element RES stacks as a screen.

name: Skill amp
detail: Applies to every hit the damage system computes, not only skill hits. At 100% amp a point is +0.5% damage; at 122%, about +0.45%. A caster's amp also scales the buffs she gives, sized when she casts; debuffs excepted, and most likely final DMG lines (inferred).

name: Enemy DMG RES
detail: Battle DR = 1 − (1 − base) × Π(1 − bonus), clamped to 0–100% when buffs apply; the damage step applies it as is.

name: Boss DMG
why: Δ ÷ (1 + Boss) on bosses; 0 on adds.
detail: Applied when the target carries the boss tag; every other target takes ×1.

name: Crit
expression: 1 + CDR × n; E = 1 + CDR × max(0, CR − CRES_t)
why: Each 100% effective crit rate = a sure tier.
detail: Linear past 100%: n = ⌊e⌋ tiers plus one more with probability e − ⌊e⌋, where e = CR − CRES_t, the effective crit rate. Per equal point, crit rate wins while CDR > e, crit DMG after.

name: Power penalty
applies_to: Hits on the Enemy side; likely Arena, stages, the Rift and daily dungeons, not Guild Conquest
detail: A server tier table keyed by your power ÷ recommended (PvE) or enemy (PvP) power sets it. The side check is read; which modes wire it is inferred from the battle controllers.

name: Floor
why: Only miss and crit rolls vary a hit.
detail: Each hit's rolls are seeded from attacker and target, so damage is deterministic given the seeds.

name: Shields, then HP
detail: Shields absorb in buffer order; the rest comes off HP, floored at 0. An invincible target shows the number but loses no HP; a map prop loses 1 HP per hit.
